cypher: MATCH (r:DLRepository)-[:DL_CONTAINS_FILE]->(f:DLFile) WHERE r.dataset=$dataset AND r.repo=$repo AND f.path=$path WITH r,f,[line IN split(f.content,'\n') WHERE trim(line) STARTS WITH 'import ' OR trim(line) STARTS WITH 'from ' OR trim(line) STARTS WITH 'using ' OR trim(line) STARTS WITH '#include' OR trim(line) STARTS WITH 'require('] AS imports UNWIND CASE WHEN size(imports)=0 THEN ['no matching import declarations'] ELSE imports[0..5] END AS line RETURN trim(line) AS entity,trim(line) AS fact,[r.id,f.id] AS evidence_ids
